title: Cold, flu, and allergy symptom overlap
goal: A teaching aid can distinguish shared symptoms from condition-specific symptoms.

rubric.must: Three labelled overlapping condition sets are visibly present.
The central three-way overlap is visibly labelled Congestion.
Pairwise symptom overlaps are visibly labelled.
Each condition has a visible unique symptom.
Labels are readable in or beside their regions.

ideal.notes: Independently authored using visual-eval/exemplars/venn/venn/ideal.svg (07e0f59e6164); rendered and visually reviewed. Three equal translucent circles; every exclusive, pairwise and triple region is labelled inside its exact region, with clearance from boundaries. No areas or counts invented.
